Ana Gomez: Heads-up - several EU trial customers report onboarding confirmations stuck and incomplete search indexes since 03:15 UTC. I pulled 82 affected tenants. Need comms + standard credit offer. :loudspeaker:

Tom Reed: Backend note: index-writer consumer laged after a short downstream 502 spike and concurrent JVM GC hiccups on two workers. Applied temporary retry-limit and scaled consumers at 1759991600. Drain ETA ~40m.

Jasmin Li: Draft customer note below. Keep tone empathetic, brief, and include booking link for 1:1s.

Jasmin Li: "Hi — we're sorry, some EU trial accounts may see slower onboarding and partial search results while we clear an indexing backlog. Engineers have applied mitigations; we expect service to normalize within 1 hour. Affected trials will receive a $150 credit automatically. If you need expedited help, book a 1:1: https://cal.redwood.ai/cs-officehours

We'll follow up with a full RCA. — Redwood Support"

Ana Gomez: Good. Standard credit $150 for trials <90 days. Offer case-by-case manual backfills for high-touch customers only. I'll DM the renewal-risk list to AEs.

Tom Reed: Deploy link: https://deploys.redwood.ai/roll/retry-limit-78 — success @ 1759991755. Queue drain: 45% in 18m, 88% in 36m.

DeployBot: Roll/retry-limit-78 completed — 4 instances updated — 1759991755

CS Bot: Incident INC-4810 logged — status: mitigated — affected=82 — office hours: https://cal.redwood.ai/cs-officehours

Jasmin Li: Sending first wave to affected trials now (in-app + email). Subject: "Quick update: onboarding delays for some EU trials". Included booking link and credit notice.

Ana Gomez: Timeline check: 1) customer note sent (Jasmin) 2) status page update when drain=100% 3) RCA & renewal-risk comms within 24h (Tom + Ana) 4) credits auto-applied and short feedback survey within 48h (Jasmin).

Tom Reed: Full drain at 1759994400. No data loss detected. Will include GC heap tuning in next release.

Ana Gomez: Thanks team. AEs will start outreach to any >$12k ARR accounts flagged. Ill collate survey results and engagement metrics here. :pray:
